# GrammarFlow

> Fix grammar, humanize stiff drafts and explain PDFs in plain words. Works in English, Hinglish, Hindi, Telugu and Kannada. Free to try, no sign-up.

## What it does
- Grammar fix and rewrite with a choice of language, style and tone, including a "My voice" mode based on your own writing sample.
- Document AI: upload a PDF or image to summarize it, explain it in simple words, fix its text (OCR) or humanize it.
- Teleprompter, voice dictation, a Chrome extension, and a beta Dev Editor that runs code and explains it.

## Good to know
- AI output can be wrong; check it before using it.
- Text you submit is sent to an AI provider for processing.

## Pages

- [Dev Editor (beta)](https://grammarflowt.vercel.app/dev-editor/)
